rules.sentence: Leukoedema’s prevalence varies among different ethnic and racial groups, with Martin et al discovering it in 58% of black individuals with no predilection for gender.[14][15]
Oral lichen planus affects 1% to 2% of patients, with the highest incidence in middle-aged females.
Oral involvement is found between 70% to 77% of patients with systemic lichen planus.[16]
